description: In OrientDB Studio (http://localhost:2480/studio/index.html), connect to the 'demodb' database using the server credentials (username: root, password: GymAnything123!). Navigate to the Schema tab. Create a new vertex class named 'Airports' that extends 'V'. After creating the class, add the following three properties to it: (1) 'Name' of type String with mandatory set to true, (2) 'IATA_Code' of type String, (3) 'City' of type String. The DemoDB is a travel agency database, so Airports is a natural entity. Save all changes.
